title.sub: 適合長者的低強度代步工具

works.description: GENESIS兼顧年長者代步與健康。電輔自行車低強度運動優勢，體力有限也能輕鬆騎行並延長行程。低跨點、低座高與三輪結構，確保穩定，適合年長者使用。
works.longDescription:
目前市售的年長者載具未能有效解決下肢退化問題，反而讓使用者加重依賴。然而，年長者出門的主要目的是促進健康。

GENESIS 讓日常代步兼顧健康，結合電輔低強度運動優勢，使體力有限者也能輕鬆騎行並延長行程。透過低跨點、低座高與優化騎乘幾何設計，搭配三輪結構，確保穩定性，更適合年長者使用。
works.english: GENESIS offers mobility and health benefits for seniors with an electric-assisted bike, ensuring easy cycling and extended range. Its low step-through, low seat, and three-wheel design provide enhanced stability, making it ideal for older users.
works.english_detail:
Current senior mobility devices often worsen lower limb degeneration, increasing dependence. 

GENESIS promotes both mobility and health, combining electric-assisted low-intensity exercise. Its low step-through, seat height, optimized geometry, and three-wheel design ensure stability and suitability for seniors.
